discourse.excerpt: To get rid of the darkness of sorrow, you have to light the lamp of happiness. To dispel the darkness of disease, you have to install the light of health.
discourse.theme: Every darkness has its own lamp — light happiness against sorrow, health against disease; Diwali begins within.
discourse.title: Light the lamp within

reflection: Swami gives us the inner meaning of Diwali: darkness comes in many forms — sorrow, peacelessness, loss — and each has its own lamp. To banish sorrow, light the lamp of happiness; to dispel disease, install the light of health. Today, name one darkness you carry and consciously light its counter-lamp — a kind word, a prayer, a small joy. That is lighting the lamp within. (Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 24, 5 Nov 1991)
seva_nudge: Light a lamp or candle at home this evening and share a sweet or a small gift with a neighbor — pass on the Diwali spirit of shared joy.
